item.title: Mick Jagger's former Australian filming retreat hits the market after major restoration work
item.description: Palerang Homestead, a stunning property in New South Wales, is up for sale after nearly three decades under family stewardship. This estate is not only historically rich, with ties to Mick Jagger during the filming of Ned Kelly, but also exemplifies sustainable farming practices that have garnered international praise. With its working farm and agricultural opportunities, this estate promises to attract diverse potential buyers, merging history with farming viability. Fuente: The Times of India - World.

item.title: ‘Welsh can tell any story’: Cymraeg dub of Star Wars premieres in Cardiff
item.description: Actors Mark Lewis Jones and Osian Morgan, who voiced characters in dub of 1977 film, among guests on red carpet It has been a memorable few days for Wales. At the weekend, the men’s rugby team secured a historic win against New Zealand – their first victory over the All Blacks in more than 70 years. Then on Thursday evening came another culturally significant moment when Cardiff rolled out the red carpet to celebrate the first Welsh-language dub of the Star Wars franchise. Stars of stage and screen who voiced the words of Luke Skywalker, Darth Vader, C-3PO et al in Welsh (Cymraeg) over the… Fuente: The Guardian - World.
